title: Routine health information system in the health facilities in Yaoundé–Cameroon: assessing the gaps for strengthening
publisher: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
why_not: A 2019 survey of 111 Yaoundé facilities scoring RHIS subdomains by respondents' opinion; it says DHIS 2 manages aggregated facility data but states no fact on where reports are keyed, which tiers enter them or how many clinics do, and nothing dated after 2019.
